title: AIR Capability Ecology Architect Method Pack
description: Reusable procedure packaged with the Capability Ecology Architect for reconstructing the complete candidate capability envelope, translating human-oriented source frameworks, applying proportionality, and selecting the smallest sufficient operative capability set.

steps.name: Establish project and task execution envelopes
steps.advance_when: Scope, environment, exposure, consequence and maturity are explicit enough to route.

steps.name: Map candidate domains
steps.advance_when: Relevant domain families and adjacent-domain triggers are visible.

steps.name: Translate human-oriented frameworks
steps.advance_when: Human status, licensure and institutional authority are separated from machine-operable capability.

steps.name: Expand the candidate capability envelope
steps.advance_when: Material constraints, evidence needs, failure modes and supporting capabilities are represented.

steps.name: Apply risk and proportionality
steps.advance_when: Mandatory floor, selected, deferred and disproportionate capability sets are distinguished.

steps.name: Select the smallest sufficient operative set
steps.advance_when: The selected set is sufficient for the current active step without silently expanding scope.

steps.name: Surface gaps and routing
steps.advance_when: Missing sources, specialist needs, domain overlays, executors and next gate are explicit.
